welcome.text: Welcome to Craps TV. Your table is ready. Let's roll!

betting-open.text: Place your bets. The table is open.

bets-locked.text: All bets are locked. Here come the dice!

come-out.text: Coming out. A brand new roll!

point-set.text: The point is set. Let's bring it home.

point-hit.text: That's the point! Pay the line!

seven-out.text: Seven out. A new shooter steps up.

natural.text: Winner, winner! Pay the pass line!

craps.text: Craps. The pass line loses this one.

push.text: That's a push. Your bet stays on the table.

player-joined.text: Another player at the table. Welcome aboard!

re-up.text: A fresh stack. You're back in the game!

session-ended.text: That's a wrap. Let's see how you rolled!

game-started.text: The table is live. Good luck, everyone!

crapless.text: Crapless craps. Every number but seven can be the point.

classic.text: Classic craps. Seven or eleven wins on the come out.

teach-mode.text: Teach mode is on. Check your phone for odds and payouts.

big-win.text: Now that's a big win. Nice shooting!

bust.text: Out of chips? Take a fresh stack and stay in the action.

disconnected.text: Waiting for the table to reconnect.
